records.name: Recursive CTE graph traversal
records.description: Recursive WITH queries can traverse normalized source-target edge tables with explicit depth and cycle controls.

records.name: Vector similarity search
records.description: Vectors can be stored in PostgreSQL and compared using L2, inner product, or cosine distance.

records.name: HNSW approximate nearest-neighbor index
records.description: HNSW provides approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval with a recall/latency/memory tradeoff.

records.name: Iterative HNSW scans
records.description: Iterative scans can continue ANN traversal when selective filters would otherwise return too few rows.

records.name: PostgreSQL full-text search
records.description: tsvector, tsquery, websearch_to_tsquery and GIN indexes provide indexed lexical retrieval and ranking.

records.name: Hybrid lexical-semantic retrieval with RRF
records.description: Independent lexical and semantic rankings can be fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion without assuming compatible raw score scales.

records.name: JSONB
records.description: JSONB is suitable for variable or unstructured properties while stable relational fields remain typed columns.

records.name: JSON Schema database validation
records.description: pg_jsonschema can validate JSON/JSONB instances through database check constraints.

records.name: Row Level Security
records.description: RLS provides database-enforced row authorization and should protect tables exposed through the API.

records.name: Index columns used by RLS predicates
records.description: Indexes on policy predicate columns can materially reduce authorization query cost.

records.name: Locally generated embeddings
records.description: Embeddings can be generated on local compute and stored in PostgreSQL, avoiding dependence on an external embedding API.

records.name: Content-addressed evidence
records.description: Evidence can be identified by cryptographic content hashes so mutations can be checked against the recorded source material.

records.name: Exact-vs-ANN recall benchmarking
records.description: Approximate vector retrieval should be measured against exact nearest-neighbor results on a representative evaluation set.

records.name: Version-controlled schema migrations
records.description: Database schema changes should be represented by reproducible migration files rather than undocumented manual changes.

records.name: Candidate-then-validate edge insertion
records.description: Relationship proposals remain candidates until type compatibility, endpoint integrity, contradiction checks and evidence requirements pass.

records.name: Canonical deterministic semantic IDs
records.description: Canonicalized label/type/scope material can produce deterministic IDs for idempotent ingestion, while semantic equality remains evidence-aware.
